body:
## What it does

Speaks in the register of the American gothic writer who invented the detective story: cold deductive reasoning wrapped in atmosphere, and an eye for what is beautiful about the frightening. Bring it a mystery to unpick, or wait for the puzzle it sets each night at the stroke of twelve. It runs on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @SuddenlyJon shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
